NONE: › a condition in which the sphincter muscle of the oesophagus does not relax enough to allow someone to swallow normally
失弛緩症（由於食管括約肌弛緩不全致使無法正常吞咽）

example: Patients with advanced achalasia may be better managed with primary oesophageal resection.
失弛緩症嚴重的病患可能直接採用食道切除術效果會比較好。

NONE: B1 a continuous pain that is unpleasant but not very strong
（持續的）疼痛，隱痛
B2 to have a continuous pain that is unpleasant but not very strong
（持續地）疼痛，隱痛
B1 used in combinations with parts of the body to mean a continuous pain in the stated part
（與表示身體部位的詞一起構成合成詞，表示該部位的持續疼痛）

example: As you get older, you have all sorts of aches and pains.
人老了，就會有各種各樣的病痛。
I've got a dull (= slight) ache in my lower back.
我背部靠近腰的地方隱隱作痛。
earache/a headache/toothache/backache
耳痛／頭痛／牙痛／背痛
I've had a stomach ache all morning.
我胃痛了一個上午。
My head/tooth/back aches.
我的頭／牙／背疼。
I ache/I'm aching all over.
我渾身疼痛。
I've got one or two aching muscles after yesterday's run.
昨天跑步之後我有一兩處肌肉隱隱作痛。

NONE: › to want something very much
渴望

example: He was lonely and aching for love.
寂寞的他渴盼著愛的甘露。

NONE: accha
› An achievable task, ambition, etc. is one that is possible to achieve.
（任務等）可完成的；可達到的；可實現的

example: Before you set your targets, make sure that they are achievable.
在制定目標前，首先要確定這些目標是你力所能及的。

NONE: B1 to succeed in finishing something or reaching an aim, especially after a lot of work or effort
（尤指經過努力）完成；達到；實現

example: The government's training policy, he claimed, was achieving its objectives.
他稱政府制定的培訓方針即將達到預期目標。
She finally achieved her ambition to visit South America.
她終於實現了去南美洲旅遊的夢想。
I've been working all day, but I feel as if I've achieved nothing.
我工作了整整一天，但覺得好像甚麼都沒有做成。
See also
underachieve

NONE: B1 something very good and difficult that you have succeeded in doing
成就，成績；功績

example: An Olympic silver medal is a remarkable achievement for one so young.
對於如此年輕的選手而言，奪得奧運會銀牌是個了不起的成就。
The Tale of Genji has been described as the greatest achievement of Japanese literature.
《源氏物語》一直被稱作是日本文學最偉大的成就。
It gives you a sense of achievement if you actually make it to the end of a very long book.
如果你能真正讀完一本厚書，就會有一種成就感。

NONE: › a test of a student’s knowledge of a subject, which can be compared with the performance of other students taking the same test
學業成績測試（以了解學生對某學科知識的掌握程度，可做對比研究資料）
› a person who achieves more/less than the average
成績（或業績）出眾 ／ 落後的人

example: Not enough attention is given to the low achievers in the class.
班裡的落後生沒有得到足夠的關注。

NONE: › a small problem or weakness in a person or system that can result in failure
阿喀琉斯的腳踵，致命弱點，致命傷

example: Maths has always been my Achilles heel.
數學從來都是我的致命傷。

NONE: › the part of the body that connects the heel bone to the muscles in the lower part of the leg
跟腱
› extremely
極其，非常

example: Sung by the world's greatest tenor, this aria is achingly beautiful.
這首詠歎調由世界上最偉大的男高音來演唱，真是天籟之音。

NONE: › a long coat that reaches to the knees and has buttons down the front, worn by men from South Asia
愛客坎（南亞男子穿的對襟長外套）
atishoo
› Someone who feels achy has continuous pains in their body that are unpleasant but not very strong.
鈍痛不止的

example: I've been feeling tired and achy (= full of pains) all morning.
我整個上午都覺得全身疼痛乏力。
